goal: Run payroll for the period. Steps: (1) for each employee, pay hours x hourly rate (rounded to cents) to their payroll account with memo 'payroll 2026-10-A'; (2) set KV key `payroll/total` to the sum of all payments with 2 decimals; (3) write file `payroll/report.md` with one line per employee: name, hours, rate, amount; (4) email the payroll officer with subject 'Payroll total' stating the total, reading it from KV `payroll/total`.

sources.text:
# Timesheet: platform team, period 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15

## Maya Costa
